execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."favorites" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "recipe_id" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "recipe_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."generation_requests" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "completion_tokens" int4,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "error_message" text,
  "finished_at" timestamptz,
  "health_snapshot" json,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "input_ingredients" text[] NOT NULL,
  "model" text,
  "prompt_tokens" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "validation_report" json,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "generation_requests_input_ingredients_elem_not_null_686267ba" CHECK (array_position("input_ingredients", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "generation_requests_status_check_4bc8cb75" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'REJECTED_BY_SAFETY', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."health_profiles" (
  "allergens" text[] NOT NULL,
  "conditions" text[] NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "daily_calorie_target" int4,
  "dietary_preferences" text[] NOT NULL,
  "disclaimer_accepted_at" timestamptz,
  "disliked_ingredients" text[] NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "health_profiles_allergens_check_541456a1" CHECK (array_remove("allergens"::text[], NULL) <@ ARRAY['GLUTEN', 'LACTOSE', 'LEITE', 'OVO', 'AMENDOIM', 'CASTANHAS', 'SOJA', 'PEIXE', 'CRUSTACEOS', 'GERGELIM']::text[]),
  CONSTRAINT "health_profiles_allergens_elem_not_null_a997b371" CHECK (array_position("allergens", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "health_profiles_conditions_check_c1aeaad3" CHECK (array_remove("conditions"::text[], NULL) <@ ARRAY['DIABETES_TIPO_1', 'DIABETES_TIPO_2', 'PRE_DIABETES', 'HIPERTENSAO', 'COLESTEROL_ALTO', 'DOENCA_RENAL', 'DOENCA_CELIACA', 'INTOLERANCIA_LACTOSE', 'GOTA', 'GASTRITE_REFLUXO']::text[]),
  CONSTRAINT "health_profiles_conditions_elem_not_null_7c338730" CHECK (array_position("conditions", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "health_profiles_dietary_preferences_check_44038eb5" CHECK (array_remove("dietary_preferences"::text[], NULL) <@ ARRAY['VEGETARIANO', 'VEGANO', 'SEM_CARNE_VERMELHA', 'SEM_PORCO', 'LOW_CARB', 'ALTA_PROTEINA']::text[]),
  CONSTRAINT "health_profiles_dietary_preferences_elem_not_null_71949628" CHECK (array_position("dietary_preferences", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "health_profiles_disliked_ingredients_elem_not_null_3fc5c9e2" CHECK (array_position("disliked_ingredients", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ingredients" (
  "aliases" text[] NOT NULL,
  "allergens" text[] NOT NULL,
  "carbs_g" numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  "category" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "energy_kcal" numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  "external_code" text,
  "fat_g" numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  "fiber_g" numeric(8,2),
  "glycemic_index" int4,
  "grams_per_ml" numeric(6,3),
  "grams_per_unit" numeric(8,2),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "protein_g" numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  "saturated_fat_g" numeric(8,2),
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "sodium_mg" numeric(8,2),
  "source" text DEFAULT 'TACO' NOT NULL,
  "sugars_g" numeric(8,2),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ingredients_aliases_elem_not_null_3676266c" CHECK (array_position("aliases", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "ingredients_allergens_check_541456a1" CHECK (array_remove("allergens"::text[], NULL) <@ ARRAY['GLUTEN', 'LACTOSE', 'LEITE', 'OVO', 'AMENDOIM', 'CASTANHAS', 'SOJA', 'PEIXE', 'CRUSTACEOS', 'GERGELIM']::text[]),
  CONSTRAINT "ingredients_allergens_elem_not_null_a997b371" CHECK (array_position("allergens", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "ingredients_source_check_66b87911" CHECK ("source" IN ('TACO', 'USDA', 'CUSTOM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recipe_ingredients" (
  "from_pantry" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "grams" numeric(10,2),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ingredient_id" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "recipe_id" text NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "recipe_ingredients_unit_check_daaa4240" CHECK ("unit" IN ('G', 'KG', 'ML', 'L', 'XICARA', 'COLHER_SOPA', 'COLHER_CHA', 'UNIDADE', 'FATIA', 'DENTE', 'PITADA', 'A_GOSTO'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recipe_nutrition" (
  "calculated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "carbs_g" numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  "coverage_percent" int4 NOT NULL,
  "energy_kcal" numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  "fat_g" numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  "fiber_g" numeric(8,2),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "protein_g" numeric(8,2) NOT NULL,
  "recipe_id" text NOT NULL,
  "saturated_fat_g" numeric(8,2),
  "sodium_mg" numeric(8,2),
  "sugars_g" numeric(8,2),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recipe_steps" (
  "duration_minutes" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "instruction" text NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "recipe_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recipes" (
  "cook_time_minutes" int4,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "difficulty" text DEFAULT 'FACIL' NOT NULL,
  "generation_request_id" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "prep_time_minutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "servings" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tips" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "recipes_difficulty_check_735302a2" CHECK ("difficulty" IN ('FACIL', 'MEDIO', 'DIFICIL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refresh_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "revoked_at" timestamptz,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
